mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_tb WHERE user_id = #{id}
select u.id, u.nickname, u.profile from friend_tb as f join user_tb as u on f.friend_id = u.id where f.user_id = #{id} and u.online_status = true
select u.id, u.nickname, u.profile from friend_tb as f join user_tb as u on f.friend_id = u.id where f.user_id = #{id} and u.online_status = false
